text.description_html:
Global DP-1204, Storefront Door Closer Drop Plate

The Drop Plate for 2200/200 Series Door Closers is for use on top jamb mounts that have limited overhead clearance or it can be used on a regular arm to clear a mortised stop or holder. It can be used with any door closer that has a mounting pattern of: 9-1/16" Horizontal Mounting Holes and 3/4" Vertical Mounting Holes. Choose from aluminum or dark bronze finishes.

For use with Global Door Controls TC201ADA, TC200 series, TC2201ADA. American Eagle 3100, American Eagle 3100 ADA or any door closer with a common 9-1/6" x 3/4"  mounting hole pattern.

Specifications: for Global DP-1214 Drop Plate

  • Finish: Aluminum or Dark Bronze
  • Horizontal Closer Mounting Holes: 9-1/16"
  • Vertical Closer Mounting Holes: 3/4"
  • Plate Width: 2-5/16"
  • Plate Length: 9-13/16"
  • Packaged with installation screws

Sold Individually
